subject: Poisson MA(1) model causes stability issues with and only with MA theta parameter

messages.author: 71c315ee557ff234
messages.subject: Poisson MA(1) model causes stability issues with and only with MA theta parameter
parts:
Hi,

after successfully applying the Poisson-AR(1), I struggled big times with 
trying so with a MA(1) structure. Attached you'll find a simulation and
STAN file GMA.stan for fitting. 

The model fits well for parameters mu and sigma, but struggles with 
parameter theta. I applied the MATT's trick, as a variant replaced
theta with tanh(theta), increased the number of iterations to iter=10000.
Nothing helped.

Thank you,
Andre

messages.subject: Re: Poisson MA(1) model causes stability issues with and only with MA theta parameter
parts:
The trace plots seems to suggest that chains can switch to a different state, possibly when theta_sd is estimated as zero or close to zero. This might happen when all the error ends up in err[t-1].


transformed parameters {

  vector[T] nu;  

  nu[1] <- mu +  err[1] * sigma;
  for (t in 2:T) {
         nu[t] <- mu + theta*err[t-1]*sigma + err[t] * sigma;



J
